ko.theme_desc: 달콤한 유혹에 빠진 인류, 붕어빵의 끈적한 촉수에 속절없이 사로잡히고 있다. 곧 붕어빵 공장에서 강제 노동을 하게 될지도.

scenarios.10y: 붕어빵 노예가 됐는데, 팥 대신 뇌를 털린 기분이야.
scenarios.20y: 붕어빵 감옥에서 탈출했는데, 붕어빵 군주가 날 보디가드로 썼대!
scenarios.30y: 붕어빵 군주랑 결혼해서 붕어빵 제국을 다스리는데, 붕어빵 세금은 없어!

en.theme_title: ⚠️ Warning: The Great Fish-Shaped Pastry Assimilation!
en.theme_desc: Humans are falling prey to the delicious allure of fish-shaped pastries, ensnared by their sticky embrace. Forced labor in the pastry factories looms.

scenarios.10y: Working for the 붕어빵 overlords, I'm pretty sure my brain is now filled with sweet bean paste.
scenarios.20y: I escaped the 붕어빵 prison, and now I'm the 붕어빵 king's personal bodyguard!
scenarios.30y: I married the 붕어빵 king and now rule the 붕어빵 empire, but at least there's no 붕어빵 tax!
